hypotheses.J1_top4_beats_adversarial_sign_null: At full edit scale, correct top-4 input modes exceed the most overlapping of four sign-null bases by at least 0.10 core-patch fidelity on both corpora.
hypotheses.J2_top4_beats_adversarial_pairing_null: At full edit scale, correct top-4 modes exceed the most overlapping of four Down/form-pairing-null bases by at least 0.10 on both corpora.
hypotheses.J3_top4_beats_unweighted_factor_span: At full edit scale, correct top-4 modes exceed the top unweighted Left/Right factor-span directions by at least 0.10 on both corpora.
hypotheses.J4_top4_survives_tangent_regime: At 10 percent edit scale, correct top-4 modes retain at least 0.70 core-patch fidelity on both corpora.
hypotheses.J5_top32_is_stable_across_scale: Correct top-32 modes reach at least 0.90 core-patch fidelity at every tested scale and corpus.
hypotheses.J6_top4_is_not_just_delta_energy: Correct top-4 modes capture at most 25 percent of raw state-delta energy while reaching at least 0.70 core fidelity on both corpora at full scale.
hypotheses.J7_null_redteam_transfers_ood: On TinyStories, correct top-4 modes beat sign, pairing, and factor controls at full scale.
